title: Active Portfolio Management in Concentrated Equity Markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.27113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The equal-weighted portfolio is a passive, rule-based strategy that has historically been difficult to outperform, delivering higher returns than the capitalization-weighted "market" benchmark across many markets and periods. Stochastic portfolio theory (SPT) reveals that this relative performance is regime dependent, with the equal-weighted portfolio underperforming during periods of increasing market concentration and high correlations, particularly market bubbles. These observations have motivated us to formulate and solve a stochastic control problem in which an investor actively allocates between the equal-weighted and market portfolios. The investor bases their allocation decisions on forecasts made under a flexible stochastic diversity--dispersion (SDD) model. translated_title: 集中化股票市场中的主动投资组合管理
translated_abstract: 等权重投资组合是一种被动的、基于规则的策略，历史上一直难以被超越，在许多市场和时期中，其收益均高于市值加权的“市场”基准。随机投资组合理论（SPT）揭示了这种相对表现依赖于市场状态：在市场集中度上升且相关性较高的时期，尤其是市场泡沫期间，等权重投资组合表现不佳。这些观察促使我们提出并求解一个随机控制问题，即投资者在等权重组合与市值组合之间进行主动配置。投资者基于一个灵活的随机多样性-离散度（SDD）模型所做出的预测来进行配置决策。通过对实施摩擦采用二次代理函数，我们通过线性正倒向随机微分方程（FBSDE）刻画最优配置，并得到了显式的“瞄准……”（aiming in fro……）形式的解。
tldr: 该论文将等权重组合与市值组合之间的主动资产配置建模为一个随机控制问题，利用随机多样性-离散度（SDD）模型进行预测，并通过线性正倒向随机微分方程推导出最优配置策略的显式解，从而应对市场集中度变化时等权重策略表现的状态依赖性。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates a stochastic control problem for actively allocating between equal-weighted and market portfolios, uses a stochastic diversity-dispersion (SDD) model for forecasts, and derives an explicit optimal allocation via a linear forward-backward SDE, addressing the regime-dependent performance of equal-weighted strategies under changing market concentration.
